title: 第46章 姑娘，能不能借点钱！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 皇宫。唐逸站在宫门外，一等就是一个时辰。一辆马车终于出现在了他的视线中。“哥哥，哥哥，我在这里……”唐音站在马车上，正拼命向她招手。小姑娘扎着好看的发髻，穿着新衣，在阳光下宛若一只翩然起舞的蝴蝶。唐逸的眼睛却有些发涩。妹妹快乐是真的，但伪装也是真的，就为了不让他担心，她宁愿自己忍着疼，也不喊一声疼。又蠢又傻，可又让人心疼。“哥哥，我给你说，小姨送给我好多好多东西呢。”“有好吃的，好玩的，还有一个漂亮的大姐姐……”唐逸正伤感呢，就看到唐音掀开车帘，从马车中拉出来了一个大美女。女人二十出头，身材高挑，身上穿着简单的白裙，不仅将凹凸有致的身材勾勒得淋漓尽致，还显得极为端庄大气。加上此时清风拂来，她一袭白裙正随风猎猎而动，宛若仙子临尘，美不胜收。不愧是跟在贵妃身边的女人，就这份气质，就不是一般大家族的小姐所能比拟的……唐逸暗暗感叹。感叹过后，就只剩下尴尬了。贤妃和母亲是闺蜜，叫一声小姨没什么问题，送唐音吃的玩的也没问题。可送个美女问题就大了。感觉就像是给他找老婆一样。关键是，唐音和他的小院就只有一间房，孤男寡女共处一室很容易擦枪走火。“杜凌菲，见过唐少爷。”女人微微欠身行礼，解答了唐逸的疑惑：“我奉娘娘之命，照顾音音小姐一段时间。”“娘娘说音音姑娘终归是姑娘，虽然还小，可少爷一直照顾终归是不方便，将来对音音小姐的声誉不好。”唐逸本来就想过段时间，给唐音买个丫鬟伺候的。毕竟唐音是女孩子，他虽然是哥哥，但很多事情做起来还是不方便。只是他没想到的是贤妃娘娘竟然也想到了这点，并且派了身边的人过来，不是说不好，就是太漂亮了……万一不小心成了伺候他，就不好了。“那就有劳姑娘了，呃……工钱照结。”唐逸挠了挠头，和女人打交道他真没什么经验啊。杜凌菲抿唇而笑。在她的记忆中，文采风流的才子，可都是风流倜傥。没想到堂堂的名动京都的小诗仙，似乎不太擅长此道啊！她是贤妃身边的女官，皇帝和贤妃谈话的时候没有避着她，她自然知道唐逸的身份。“哥哥，姐姐很漂亮，但你不能把我忘记了啊！”唐音在马车上一蹦一跳的，宣布主权：“哥哥我还在这里呢，我昨晚都没睡好，我好想你啊。”唐逸摇头，怎么有种争宠的既视感？“走，咱们回家。”他也没有揭穿唐音隐瞒受伤的事，伸手将她抱了起来。“嗯，回家。”唐音重重点头。虽然小姨很好，小姨和娘一样很温柔，可是哥哥在哪里，哪里才是家。杜凌菲看着前方兄妹俩打闹着离开，顿时有些无语，有马车不坐？你们想要走回唐家吗？那得走两个时辰啊！她只能跳下马车跟在兄妹俩身后，同时让车夫驱车跟在后面。直到杜凌菲看到唐逸让唐音自己去买吃的，自己去买玩具，还自己手插着腰和那些商贩讨价还价，她才明白了唐逸的用意。他是在帮妹妹疗伤呢！身体上的伤十天半月就能好，可心理上的伤呢？心理上的伤很难治疗，若是治疗不好，将会是陪伴一生的梦魇。唐逸要做的，显然就是让妹妹开朗起来！想到昨晚那个躲在床角瑟瑟发抖的女孩，再看现在双手叉腰意气风发的女孩，杜凌菲忽然觉得……或许有一种爱，真的能抚平一切伤害吧？“咳，那个，杜姑娘，能不能借点钱……”唐逸的声音传来。“嗯？”杜凌菲眨了眨眼，有些诧异地看着身侧面色尴尬的少年。说好的工钱照结呢？“咳，昨晚被关在监狱，钱没了……”唐逸说得很模糊，故意掩去了去青楼的事情。杜凌菲取下腰间的荷包，从里面取出一百两银票递给唐逸。在唐逸伸手去接的时候，杜凌菲忽然向后缩了一下，唇角微扬：“疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏，唐少爷写得非常好。”“娘娘说，那姑娘能获得唐少亲手写的两句诗，是她的造化。”呃，这语气怎么听得有些酸呢？唐逸手抚着下巴，目光打量着杜凌菲：“行吧，也给你写一首。”“云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓。”“若非群玉山头见，会向瑶台月下逢。”话落，唐逸抬手抽掉她手中的一百两：“算你买的！”杜凌菲却已经呆在当场，俏脸震惊，美眸瞪大。她原本只是想要逗弄一下唐逸而已，毕竟堂堂名动京都的大诗仙，竟然沦落到要和他借钱！没想到这家伙竟然误会了她的意思，开口就给她来了一首美人诗。杜凌菲是贤妃身边的女官，但也是出身书香门第，是为了逃婚故意进宫伺候贤妃的，因此她很清楚唐逸给她写的这首诗，含金量有多高。哪怕她出身书香门第，哪怕她容颜绝世，可是仔细品过这首诗后，不知道为何，杜凌菲总觉得自己似乎有点配不上这首诗啊！这首诗要是流传出去，能够震动整个大炎文坛。“这笨蛋！”杜凌菲看着给唐音付账的唐逸，忽然有些咬牙切齿：“一点都不解风情，这时候怎么能说买呢？”只是看这家伙的样子，似乎一首震烁古今的诗词，好像还没有那一百两重要啊！她快步跟上唐逸，低声道：“名字叫什么？”唐逸知道牵着唐音，知道她说的是李白的诗，道：“清平调丶赠杜凌菲。”杜凌菲脚步微微一滞，俏脸微红。呃，这家伙，看起来也不是完全不懂。唐逸和杜凌菲带着唐音足足逛了一个多时辰，直到东西将马车塞得满满当当地装不下了，唐音才心满意足地回到马车。或是因为太累了，唐音上车没一会儿，就在唐逸的怀中睡了过去。趁着唐音睡觉，唐逸掀开了女孩的新衣，果然看到了她身上密密麻麻的挫伤和瘀伤。宫里的药很好，擦了药女孩身上的伤已经结咖，可看上去依旧惨不忍睹。这要是没有擦药，她得多疼？她昨日给自己清洗干净，回到房间强行挤出笑容，问能不能帮自己画图的时候，她得忍受多大的痛苦？“唐浩，林竹，我饶不了你们！”唐逸双目通红，低声怒吼。
content_en: royal palace.Tang Yi stood outside the palace gate and waited for an hour.A carriage finally appeared in his sight."Brother, brother, I'm here..." Tang Yin stood on the carriage and waved to her desperately.The little girl wore a beautiful bun and new clothes, looking like a dancing butterfly in the sun.Tang Yi's eyes were a little astringent.It's true that my sister is happy, but the disguise is also true. Just to prevent him from worrying, she would rather endure the pain than cry out in pain.It's silly and silly, but it's also heart-wrenching."Brother, let me tell you, my aunt gave me a lot of things." "There are delicious things, fun things, and a beautiful big sister..." Tang Yizheng was feeling sad when he saw Tang Yin lift the curtain and pull out a beautiful woman from the carriage.The woman is in her early twenties, tall and wearing a simple white skirt, which not only outlines her curvy figure, but also looks extremely dignified.In addition, the breeze was blowing at this time, and her white dress was moving with the wind, like a fairy coming to the dust, so beautiful.She is worthy of being the woman who follows the imperial concubine. Her temperament is not comparable to that of a young lady from a big family... Tang Yi secretly sighed.After sighing, all that was left was embarrassment.Concubine Xian and her mother were best friends, so it was no problem to call her aunt, and it was no problem to give Tang Yin food and entertainment.But sending a beautiful woman is a big problem.It feels like finding him a wife.The key is that Tang Yin and his small courtyard only have one room, and it is easy for a man and a woman to live together in the same room."Du Lingfei, I have met Master Tang." The woman bowed slightly and saluted, answering Tang Yi's doubts: "I have been ordered by the empress to take care of Miss Yinyin for a period of time." "The empress said that Miss Yinyin is a girl after all. Although she is still young, it is inconvenient for the young master to take care of Miss Yinyin all the time. It will not be good for Miss Yinyin in the future." Tang Yi had originally thought about buying a maid for Tang Yin for a while.After all, Tang Yin is a girl. Although he is the older brother, it is still inconvenient to do many things.But what he didn't expect was that Concubine Xian had also thought of this and sent someone around her. Either she said it was bad or she was too beautiful... It would be bad if she accidentally ended up serving him."Then it's up to you, girl, uh... the salary will be taken care of." Tang Yi scratched his head, he really had no experience in dealing with women.Du Lingfei pursed her lips and smiled.In her memory, all the talented people with literary talents were suave and elegant.Unexpectedly, the famous little poet in Kyoto seems not to be very good at this!She was the female official next to Concubine Xian. The emperor did not avoid her when talking to Concubine Xian, so she naturally knew Tang Yi's identity."Brother, sister is very beautiful, but you can't forget me!" Tang Yin jumped up and down on the carriage and declared her sovereignty: "Brother, I'm still here. I didn't sleep well last night. I miss you so much." Tang Yi shook his head, why did he feel like he was competing for favor?"Let's go home." He didn't expose Tang Yin's concealment of the injury, and stretched out his hand to hug her."Well, go home." Tang Yin nodded heavily.Although my aunt is very kind and gentle like my mother, home is where my brother is.Du Lingfei watched the two brothers and sisters leaving in front of her, and she was speechless. There was a carriage and you didn't want to sit in it?Do you want to go back to the Tang family?It takes two hours to walk!She could only jump out of the carriage and follow the brothers and sisters, while asking the coachman to drive behind them.It wasn't until Du Lingfei saw Tang Yi asking Tang Yin to buy food and toys by herself, and even bargaining with the vendors with her hands on her waist, that she understood Tang Yi's intention.He is helping his sister heal!Physical injuries can be cured in ten and a half months, but what about psychological injuries?Psychological injuries are difficult to treat. If not treated well, it will be a lifelong nightmare.What Tang Yi wants to do is obviously to make his sister cheerful!Thinking of the trembling girl hiding in the corner of the bed last night, and looking at the girl with her hands on her hips now in high spirits, Du Lingfei suddenly felt... maybe there is a kind of love that can really heal all hurts, right?"Ahem, um, Miss Du, can you borrow some money..." Tang Yi's voice came."Huh?" Du Lingfei blinked and looked at the awkward-looking young man beside him with some surprise.Will the agreed wages be paid?"Ahem, I was imprisoned in jail last night and I ran out of money..." Tang Yi spoke very vaguely, deliberately covering up the matter of going to a brothel.Du Lingfei took off the purse from her waist, took out a hundred taels of silver notes and handed it to Tang Yi.When Tang Yi reached out to pick it up, Du Lingfei suddenly shrank back and raised the corners of her lips slightly: "The sparse shadows are slanting across the clear water, and the faint fragrance floats in the moonlit dusk. Master Tang wrote very well." "The empress said that it was her good fortune that the girl got two lines of poems written by Master Tang himself." Uh, why does this tone sound sour?Tang Yi stroked his chin with his hand and looked at Du Lingfei: "Okay, I'll write a poem for you too." "The clouds are like the clothes and the flowers are like the face, and the spring breeze blows the threshold and the dew is rich." "If we hadn't met on the top of the jade mountain, we would have met under the moon at Yaotai." After saying this, Tang Yi raised his hand and took away the one hundred taels in her hand: "You bought it!" Du Lingfei had already stayed on the spot, her pretty face was shocked, and her beautiful eyes were wide open.She originally just wanted to tease Tang Yi, but after all, the famous poet in Kyoto was reduced to asking to borrow money from him!Unexpectedly, this guy misunderstood her meaning and wrote her a beautiful poem.Du Lingfei was the female official next to Concubine Xian, but she also came from a scholarly family. She deliberately entered the palace to serve Concubine Xian in order to escape from marriage, so she knew very well how valuable the poem Tang Yi wrote for her was.Even though she came from a scholarly family, even though she had a peerless appearance, after reading this poem carefully, for some reason, Du Lingfei always felt that she was not worthy of this poem!If this poem spreads, it will shock the entire Dayan literary world."This idiot!" Du Lingfei looked at Tang Yi who was paying the bill for Tang Yin, and suddenly gritted her teeth: "I don't understand the style at all, how can I say buy it at this time?" Just looking at this guy's look, it seems that a poem that shocked the past and the present is not as important as the one hundred taels!She quickly followed Tang Yi and whispered: "What's your name?" Tang Yi knew that she was holding Tang Yin's hand, and knew that she was talking about Li Bai's poem, and said: "Qing Ping Diao, a gift to Du Lingfei." Du Lingfei's steps faltered slightly, and her pretty face turned red.Well, this guy doesn't seem to understand at all.Tang Yi and Du Lingfei took Tang Yin shopping for more than an hour. Only when the carriage was so packed with things that it couldn't be loaded anymore, Tang Yin returned to the carriage with satisfaction.
title_en: Chapter 46 Girl, can you borrow some money?
